replyDrafts.subject: Re: Strava has GPS. Latent doesn't.
replyDrafts.theirMessage:
Hi Eddie,

You describe Latent as a Strava for work, and I think that's the right comparison. But Strava has GPS, so a 10K really is a 10K. Latent knows I was recording, but not what I did on my computer, and that's where the work happens.

I'd track the computer too. It could read which apps and sites you use, and AI could check snapshots of the session against what you said you'd work on. After five hours, you'd see that only two were real work.

The best part would be seeing why. Say a Discord message at 17:20 turned into an hour on YouTube. You'd see exactly that, and next time you'd know what to fix. I think people would open the app just for that.

It would also make groups stronger, because streaks and nudges would be based on real hours.

I've attached a wireframe and five things I'd try first. I'm 21, from Czechia, and I build my own products, most recently elasty.uk and AI modeling software for formula student.
